candidates.title: Prepare a workflow-template review checklist

demandEvidence.chore: Seek guidance on a workflow-template submission after three rejections.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I’m looking for some guidance regarding a workflow template submission that has been rejected three times.

ease.reason: A student could turn operator-supplied submission rules into a checklist, but the post gives no rules or implementation reference.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: workflow consultants may pay for submission-readiness help; this request establishes no buyer or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock could check sample templates against supplied rules, but no rules or evaluation criteria are attached.

autonomy.reason: A proposed checklist could flag missing items, while a person must interpret rules and decide readiness; no automation source is attached.

evidence.reason: The fresh post supports a request for guidance after three rejections, but states no checklist criteria, repeat frequency, or implementation evidence.

candidates.reason: Assessed as a bounded sample-template checklist experiment. The post establishes the guidance request, but lacks actual sticky-note requirements or other criteria needed for a useful checker, so the provisional mean is below threshold.

rejected.title: Prepare a workflow-template review checklist
rejected.reason: Below threshold: the post asks for guidance after three workflow-template rejections but supplies no actual requirements to check. The proposed sample checklist cannot be meaningfully scoped from the attached evidence.
